signature.name: VTask.mk'
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> [CommSemiring R] -> {A : Type u_2} -> [CommSemiring A] -> [Algebra R A] -> {M : Type u_3} -> [AddCancelCommMonoid M] -> [Module R M] -> [Module A M] -> (D : A →ₗ[R] M) -> (h : ∀ (a b : A), D (a * b) = a • D b + b • D a) -> Derivation R A M

conventions.statement: The condition D 1 = 0 is not an explicit input; it is deduced from h together with the AddCancelCommMonoid structure of M by evaluating the Leibniz rule at a = b = 1 and cancelling.
conventions.note: This is what distinguishes VTask.mk' from the base Derivation constructor.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {M : Type*} [AddCancelCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] (D : A →ₗ[R] M) (h : ∀ (a b : A), D (a * b) = a • D b + b • D a), VTask.mk' D h 1 = 0

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {M : Type*} [AddCancelCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] (D : A →ₗ[R] M) (h : ∀ (a b : A), D (a * b) = a • D b + b • D a) (a b : A), VTask.mk' D h (a * b) = a • VTask.mk' D h b + b • VTask.mk' D h a

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {M : Type*} [AddCancelCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] (D : A →ₗ[R] M) (h : ∀ (a b : A), D (a * b) = a • D b + b • D a) (r : R) (a : A), VTask.mk' D h (r • a) = r • VTask.mk' D h a

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {M : Type*} [AddCancelCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] (D : A →ₗ[R] M) (h : ∀ (a b : A), D (a * b) = a • D b + b • D a) (a b : A), VTask.mk' D h (a + b) = VTask.mk' D h a + VTask.mk' D h b

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {M : Type*} [AddCancelCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] (D : A →ₗ[R] M) (h : ∀ (a b : A), D (a * b) = a • D b + b • D a), ¬(VTask.mk' D h 1 ≠ 0)
